Working with DocBrain knowledge bases to understand how documents are processed, organized, and made available for retrieval.

personalInfo.bio: I’m a software engineer with 3 years of experience building web applications, analytics platforms, and AI-enabled features. I bring React and Next.js interfaces to life, connect them to reliable APIs, and turn complex business requirements into usable products.
personalInfo.currentFocus: At Enterprisebot, I’m working with Python-based RAG systems, DocBrain knowledge bases, document chunking, and vector databases — exploring how the right information reaches the right answer.

projects.title: Omni-Channel Analytics Dashboard
projects.description: A responsive dashboard bringing multi-platform ad performance into one view. I owned its design and development, integrated GA4 and Search Console APIs, and added lazy loading for better performance.

projects.title: AI-Orchestrated Mobile Application Suite
projects.description: Cross-platform mobile applications built around reusable UI components. I translated business requirements into structured feature flows and used GPT-4 to accelerate parts of development.

projects.title: AI-Driven Creative Ad Generator
projects.description: A user-facing interface for personalized ad creatives, connecting GPT-4 and vector search through REST APIs. I built responsive components and handled frontend API integration end-to-end.

projects.title: Distributed Ad Data Ingestion System
projects.description: Backend pipelines processing large volumes of ad data for real-time frontend dashboards. I contributed to data parsing and query optimization to improve delivery speed for the analytics UI.
